title: Seven Palestinians Killed in Multiple Israeli Strikes Across Gaza
detail: Seven Palestinians died in multiple Israeli strikes across Gaza. In al-Mawasi, one man was killed and two children were injured in a strike the IDF said targeted a Hamas operative. Additional strikes hit a displacement tent in western Gaza City and a target in Khan Younis. Popular Resistance Committees confirmed the death of senior leader Waheed Abu Salem. Separately, a Gaza City airstrike killed Mohammed al-Wahidi, public relations director for the Egyptian Committee for Aid to Gaza, and two others.

sources.name: Wikipedia (Timeline of the Israeli–Palestinian conflict in 2026, citing wire and Gaza MoH reporting)

media.caption: Seven Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes across Gaza, including PRC leader Waheed Abu Salem and Egyptian aid official Mohammed al-Wahidi — July 7, 2026
